items.title: What Does Valero Energy (VLO) Gain From Adding Matt Audette To Its Board?
items.summary: Valero Energy (NYSE: VLO) has appointed Matt Audette as an independent director and member of its Audit Committee. Audette currently serves as chief financial officer of LPL Financial and previously held the EVP/CFO role at E*TRADE. The board assigned Audette to the Audit Committee, adding deep financial reporting and regulatory experience to that group.
